title: Energized for real-world impact
summary: Berkeley Engineering showcases Gridware’s founding alumni and how its Gridscope product tackles the threat of wildfires.
body_markdown:
Berkeley Engineering features Gridware founders and UC Berkeley alumni, Tim Barat, Hall Chen and Abdulrahman Bin Omar.


The article discusses the origins of Gridware, why the team chose to focus on wildfire mitigation and the role that Berkeley Engineering played in applying sensor technology to the existing power grid. The team also acknowledges key supporters, the CITRIS Foundry and Y Combinator.


‍


Read the full article here:[https://engineering.berkeley.edu/news/2023/01/energized-for-real-world-impact/](https://engineering.berkeley.edu/news/2023/01/energized-for-real-world-impact/)
